svg.title: BenchRouter Core Design
svg.text: Zero-Adaptation LLM Evaluation via Containerized Benchmark Routing

g.text: No Python version, no ML framework, no Ray cluster
Failed tasks don't block successful ones
File-based storage, ls + jq to debug
Auto-discover Dockerfile, build & cache on first run
Bridge scripts translate; scoring logic untouched
